collector_source:
"""Verify frozen source, Git index, real media, rights and retained failed gates."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,io,json,math,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageSequence
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];out=root/'docs/assets/mask-track-20261016';proofs=root/'docs/validation/evidence'
def load(path):return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(path):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def decode(path,w,h,pix,channels):
 result=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-protocol_whitelist','file,pipe','-i',str(path),'-map','0:v:0','-an','-fps_mode','passthrough','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt',pix,'pipe:1'],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120)
 return np.frombuffer(result.stdout,np.uint8).reshape(-1,h,w,channels)
regression=load(root/'product/.runtime/mask_tracking_full_regression_20261016.json')
assert regression['status']=='passed' and regression['test_count']==405 and regression['source_file_count']==85
assert regression['source_sha256_before']==regression['source_sha256_after']
assert all(sha(root/name)==digest for name,digest in regression['source_sha256_after'].items())
names=sorted(regression['source_sha256_after'])
result=subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.autocrlf=false','cat-file','--batch'],input=('\n'.join(':'+name for name in names)+'\n').encode('utf-8'),capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=60)
stream=io.BytesIO(result.stdout)
for name in names:
 fields=stream.readline().split();assert len(fields)==3 and fields[1]==b'blob',name
 data=stream.read(int(fields[2]));assert stream.read(1)==b'\n'
 assert 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==regression['source_sha256_after'][name],name
logs={}
for label,stem in [('full-regression','mask_tracking_full_regression_20261016.log'),('targeted','mask_tracking_targeted_20261016_final.log'),('alpha-before','mask_tracking_alpha_before_20261016.log'),('alpha-after','mask_tracking_alpha_after_20261016.log'),('before-rollback-fix','mask_tracking_targeted_20261016_c.log'),('interrupted-full','mask_tracking_full_regression_20261016-before-alpha-fix.log')]:
 source=root/'product/.runtime'/stem;target=proofs/f'mask-tracking-{label}-20261016.log';target.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
 text=target.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig');match=re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s',text)
 logs[label]={'path':target.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(target),'test_count':int(match[1]) if match else None,'seconds':float(match[2]) if match else None,'terminal_tail':text.splitlines()[-1] if text.splitlines() else ''}
assert logs['full-regression']['sha256']==regression['log_sha256'] and logs['full-regression']['terminal_tail']=='OK'
assert logs['targeted']['test_count']==26 and logs['targeted']['terminal_tail']=='OK'
assert logs['alpha-before']['terminal_tail'].startswith('FAILED') and logs['alpha-after']['terminal_tail']=='OK'
aborted=load(root/'product/.runtime/mask_tracking_full_regression_20261016-before-alpha-fix.json');assert aborted['test_count'] is None and aborted['exit_code']!=0
public=load(out/'evidence.json');assert public['generator_sha256']==sha(root/'scripts/smoke_mask_tracking.py')
assert all(sha(root/name)==digest for name,digest in public['source_sha256'].items())
assert all(sha(out/name)==entry['sha256'] and (out/name).stat().st_size==entry['bytes'] for name,entry in public['files'].items())
assert len(public['calls'])==16 and all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in public['calls'])
truth=load(out/'truth.json')['frames'];mask=decode(out/'selected-mask.mov',320,180,'rgba',4)
assert len(mask)==64
report=load(out/'mask-track-report.json');assert len(report['frames'])==65 and report['frames'][-1]['at_seconds']==4.
assert 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(mask[:,:,:,3].tobytes()).hexdigest()==report['mask_review']['gray_sha256']
for index,frame in enumerate(mask):
 ys,xs=np.nonzero(frame[:,:,3]>127);bbox=[int(xs.min()*2),int(ys.min()*2),int((xs.max()+1)*2),int((ys.max()+1)*2)]
 assert bbox==truth[index]['bbox_source_pixels']
 assert all(abs(a-b)<1e-9 for a,b in zip([report['frames'][index]['x']*640,report['frames'][index]['y']*360],truth[index]['center_source_pixels']))
 assert len(xs)==report['mask_review']['frames'][index]['selected_pixels']
arrays={name:decode(out/name,w,h,'rgb24',3) for name,w,h in [('source.mp4',640,360),('bound.mp4',640,360),('bound-transformed.mp4',640,360),('portrait.mp4',360,640),('mask-tracking-comparison.mp4',1088,248),('before-alpha-fix-bound.mp4',640,360)]}
assert all(len(value)==64 for value in arrays.values())
measurements={}
for name in ['bound.mp4','bound-transformed.mp4','portrait.mp4']:
 rows=[]
 for index,frame in enumerate(arrays[name]):
  ys,xs=np.nonzero((frame[:,:,0]>180)&(frame[:,:,1]<95)&(frame[:,:,2]>165));assert len(xs)>20
  actual=[float(xs.mean()),float(ys.mean())];x,y=truth[index]['center_source_pixels']
  if name=='bound-transformed.mp4':
   angle=math.pi/12;dx,dy=(x-320)*.78,(y-180)*.78;expected=[.52*640+dx*math.cos(angle)-dy*math.sin(angle),.48*360+dx*math.sin(angle)+dy*math.cos(angle)]
  elif name=='portrait.mp4':
   crop_x=round(x/640-(360/640)/(640/360)/2,6)*640;expected=[(x-crop_x)*(640/360),y*(640/360)]
  else:expected=[x,y]
  error=math.hypot(actual[0]-expected[0],actual[1]-expected[1]);assert error<=3
  assert abs(error-public['marker_measurements'][name]['rows'][index]['euclidean_error_pixels'])<1e-9
  rows.append(error)
 measurements[name]={'frames':len(rows),'max_error_pixels':max(rows),'mean_error_pixels':sum(rows)/len(rows),'tolerance_pixels':3.,'passed':True}
padding=[];before_padding=[]
for index,row in enumerate(truth):
 x,y=row['center_source_pixels']
 for dx in [-30,30]:
  source=arrays['source.mp4'][index,y-1:y+2,x+dx-1:x+dx+2].astype(np.int16)
  for name,acc in [('bound.mp4',padding),('before-alpha-fix-bound.mp4',before_padding)]:
   acc.append(float(np.abs(arrays[name][index,y-1:y+2,x+dx-1:x+dx+2].astype(np.int16)-source).mean()))
assert max(padding)<=20 and max(before_padding)>20
assert abs(max(padding)-public['transparent_padding']['max_mean_absolute_rgb_error'])<1e-9
with Image.open(out/'mask-tracking-comparison.gif') as handle:durations=[frame.info['duration'] for frame in ImageSequence.Iterator(handle)]
assert len(durations)==32 and sum(durations)==4000
historical=load(out/'alpha-padding-before.json');assert all(sha(out/name)==entry['sha256'] for name,entry in historical['actual_pre_fix_files'].items())
natural_root=root/'product/.runtime/mask-track-natural-20261016';natural=load(natural_root/'summary.json');after=load(natural_root/'after-alpha-fix.json')
assert [c['exit_code'] for c in natural['calls']]==[0,0,0,0,2,0,0,7,0,0,0]
assert natural['checkpoint_result']['passed']==4 and natural['checkpoint_result']['checked']==5
assert natural['marker_measurement']['passed'] is False and after['marker_measurement']['passed'] is False
assert natural['marker_measurement']['max_error_pixels']>3 and after['marker_measurement']['max_error_pixels']>3
assert after['baseline_summary_sha256']==sha(natural_root/'summary.json') and after['call']['exit_code']==0
assert after['source_sha256']==after['source_sha256_current'] and after['mask_sha256']==after['mask_sha256_current']
assert set(natural['mask_model_rights_parents'])=={'source','visual_adapter_sam2_local'}
assert natural['failed_gate_metadata_unchanged'] and natural['failed_report_survived_rollback'] and natural['package_preserved_binding_and_rights_closure'] and natural['publish_output_absent']
skill_audit=proofs/'skills-audit-mask-tracking-20261016.json';skills=load(skill_audit)
assert len(skills['results'])==14 and not skills['broken_links'] and all(v['validator_exit_code']==0 and v['installed_directory_resolves_to_repo'] for v in skills['results'])
for entry in skills['results']:assert sha(root/'skills'/entry['skill']/'SKILL.md')==entry['sha256']
record={'checked_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'controlled-functionality-verified-natural-mask-and-marker-quality-unaccepted',
